questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “She has been suffering ____ fever since Monday.”
questions.why: Suffer from an illness. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Everest is the ____ peak in the world.”
questions.why: Superlative of 'high' is 'highest'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the error: “The quality of the mangoes were excellent.”
questions.why: The subject is 'quality' (singular): 'was'. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct modal: “He ____ to play cricket every evening, but now he doesn’t.”
questions.why: 'Used to' expresses a past habit that no longer exists. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “genuine”:
questions.why: 'Genuine' means real or authentic. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct active voice: “The thief was caught by the police.”
opts: The police had caught the thief.
The police was catching the thief.
questions.why: Past simple passive converts to past simple active. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the conjunction relationship: “Although he was ill, he attended office.”
questions.why: 'Although' introduces a contrast (concession). GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Change into passive voice: “The teacher praised the student.”
opts: The student was praised by the teacher.
The student has been praised by the teacher.
The teacher was praised by the student.
The student is praised by the teacher.
questions.why: Simple past becomes 'was praised'. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “She is fond ______ classical music.”
questions.why: 'Fond of'. GPSC-style practice item, modelled on the 2026 grammar blocks.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “She is married with a surgeon.”
opts: She is married by a surgeon.
She is married for a surgeon.
She is married from a surgeon.
She is married to a surgeon.
questions.why: 'Married to' is the correct collocation. GPSC-style practice item.
